name: CFF Fluid Control Ltd
summary: CFF Fluid Control Limited manufactures, overhauls, repairs, and maintains shipboard machinery, combat systems, reference, and test facilities for submarines and surface ships for Indian navy. The company offers defence solutions for ships and submarines, including indigenization, manufacturing, integration, installation and commissioning of systems and through life cycle support for various ships and submarines and unmanned platforms; rapid prototyping and exotic material precision fabrication for land and air platforms from turbo charger assemblies for tanks to wings and fins of next generation missiles; and support services comprising complex structural repairs, overhaul of mechanical, electrical, communication, navigation systems, and provision of lifecycle support. It is also involved in the manufacture of critical components, assemblies, sub-assemblies, equipment, and systems; and strategic projects which includes rapid prototyping, concept to commissioning equipment, and integrating systems for manned and unmanned platforms. In addition, the company provides specialized solutions for energy, including manufacturing and installation of fuel handling transport and storage to water and toxic gas monitoring systems, such as steam and water analyzer and wet rack systems; and installs and commissions on- board, mobile, and land based clean energy applications, as well as engages in retrofitting new builds in the clean energy propulsion arena for locomotive and marine based assets. CFF Fluid Control Limited was incorporated in 2012 and is based in Mumbai, India.
